title: CraftsFile
description: The JSON shape of one file in `data/crafts/`.

$schema.description:
Optional: the JSON Schema this file follows, so editors can check
it as you type (`"$schema": "../schema/crafts.schema.json"`).

makes.description: The id of the item it makes.

material.description: What they're made of: `own` (the default) or `from_used`.

needs.description: Tool levels it needs, all of them, like `{ "CUT": 1 }`. Optional.

seconds.description: How long it takes, in seconds.

uses.description:
The items it uses up from your pockets, each optionally only of a
material with a tag. You know the craft once you've carried every
kind of item it uses. Optional: none, and then it's always known.

CraftMaterial.description: What a crafted item is made of.

oneOf.description: The made item's own material, from `data/items/`.
The material of the first item used.

Use.description:
Some items a recipe uses up: `count` of the item type `item`, made of
any material, or only of materials with the tag `tag`.

tag.description:
Only items made of a material with this tag count, like `"metal"`:
bone scrap won't patch the hull. Optional: any material.
